decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Site Location Plan Received: 20 March 2014 S01, S02, S03, P03 Received: 28 March 2014 P01, P02 Received: 13 May 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment produced and provided with the application and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.
description: Creation of a lightwell in front garden and conversion of basement to playroom / study room
